Watch Together

  1. Open your movie here and pause it.
  2. In Google Meet click Share screen (in Zoom / Teams: Share) and choose Chrome Tab / A tab.
  3. Pick this tab and turn on Also share tab audio.
  4. Press play. Use F for fullscreen so everyone sees a bigger picture.

Tab audio sharing works in Chrome and Edge on desktop. Don't use Picture-in-Picture while sharing — the video leaves this tab and your friends will see a blank player.
